arguments.summary: Investigated the cause of the failed-jobs backlog. Found that the cron drift was due to the container running on UTC while the schedule was written in local time. Raised the ingress idle timeout to stop 502s. Replaced the expired intermediate certificate. The failed-jobs backlog had 1204 entries, 47 of which were malformed rows. Primary query shows 1257 failed jobs as of now.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root cause of the failed jobs and ensure they are resolved to prevent future failures.
